data.one_liner: Detects root, jailbreak, emulators, and debugging environments on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that checks if the host device is compromised by being rooted on Android or jailbroken on iOS. It also detects if the app is running in an emulator or being debugged.
use_when: You are building a high-security app (banking, enterprise) that needs to block rooted or jailbroken devices
You need to detect emulator environments or active debugging sessions
avoid_when: Your application does not require device security or anti-tamper checks
strengths: Combines root, jailbreak, emulator, and debugging checks into a single plugin
Uses established underlying native libraries like RootBeer and IOSSecuritySuite
weaknesses: Root and jailbreak detection can sometimes produce false positives or be bypassed by advanced users
data.setup_notes: Android requires no special configurations. iOS requires adding specific application query schemes to the Info.plist file.
